[98] Whose life is perfect, complete and eternal, without beginning or end, and through whom all created life originated and continues.
[99] Dependent on none for His existence while being the sustainer and administrator of all created existence.
[100] Allāh's knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.
[101] Chair or footstool. It is not to be confused with al-ʿArsh (the Throne) , which is infinitely higher and greater than al-Kursī.
[102] Above all of His creations and superior to them in essence, rank and position.
[103] Whose greatness is unlimited, beyond description or imagination.] [Al-Baqarah: 255]. He told me: 'A guardian from Allah will remain over you, and no devil will approach you until morning' ...

items.ar: البخاري 2311
items.tr: Al-Bukhari 2311

items.ar: قراءة الآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في الليل
items.tr: Reading the last two ayat of Surah Al-Baqarah at night

items.ar: اقرأ الآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلتك
items.tr: Read the last two ayat (verses) of Surah Al-Baqarah tonight

items.ar: … مَنْ قَرَأَ بِالْآيَتَيْنِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ
items.tr: … Whoever reads the last two ayat (verses) of Surah Al-Baqarah during a night, they will suffice him.

items.ar: البخاري 5051
items.tr: Al-Bukhari 5051

items.ar: النفث في الكفين بالمعوذات ومسح الجسد عند الفراش
items.tr: Blowing lightly into the palms with Al-Muawwidhat and wiping the body at bedtime

items.ar: اجمع كفيك واقرأ فيهما المعوذات ثم امسح بهما جسدك ثلاثا
items.tr: Bring your palms together, recite Al-Muawwidhat into them, then wipe your body with them three times

items.ar: … كَانَ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ جَمَعَ كَفَّيْهِ، ثُمَّ نَفَثَ فِيهِمَا فَقَرَأَ فِيهِمَا: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ وَقُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الفَلَقِ وَقُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ، يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقْبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ
items.tr: … Every night when he went to bed, he brought his palms together, blew lightly into them and recited into them Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad, Qul Audhu bi-Rabb al-Falaq and Qul Audhu bi-Rabb an-Nas. Then he wiped as much of his body as he could, beginning with his head, face and the front of his body. He did this three times.

items.ar: البخاري 5017
items.tr: Al-Bukhari 5017

items.ar: النوم أول الليل والقيام آخره
items.tr: Sleeping at the beginning of the night and rising at its end

items.ar: نم أول الليل وقم آخره للصلاة
items.tr: Sleep at the beginning of the night and rise at its end for salah (prayer)

items.ar: … كَانَ يَنَامُ أَوَّلَهُ وَيَقُومُ آخِرَهُ، فَيُصَلِّي، ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ، فَإِذَا أَذَّنَ المُؤَذِّنُ وَثَبَ، فَإِنْ كَانَ بِهِ حَاجَةٌ، اغْتَسَلَ وَإِلَّا تَوَضَّأَ وَخَرَجَ
items.tr: … He slept at its beginning and rose at its end to pray, then returned to bed. When the muadhdhin (caller to prayer) called, he got up quickly. If he needed to bathe, he bathed; otherwise, he performed wudu (ablution) and went out.

items.ar: البخاري 1146
items.tr: Al-Bukhari 1146

items.ar: ذكر من استيقظ في الليل
items.tr: Dhikr (remembrance) for someone who wakes at night

items.ar: اذكر الله وادعه إذا استيقظت من الليل
items.tr: Remember Allah and supplicate to Him when you wake during the night

items.ar: … مَنْ تَعَارَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَقَالَ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، أَوْ دَعَا، اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ، فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأَ وَصَلَّى قُبِلَتْ صَلاَتُهُ
items.tr: … Whoever wakes during the night and says: 'None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. All praise belongs to Allah. Glory be to Allah. None is worthy of worship except Allah. Allah is greatest. There is no power or strength except through Allah,' then says, 'O Allah, forgive me,' or supplicates, will be answered. If he performs wudu (ablution) and offers salah (prayer), his prayer will be accepted.

items.ar: البخاري 1154
items.tr: Al-Bukhari 1154

items.ar: السواك عند القيام من الليل
items.tr: Siwak (tooth-cleaning stick) when rising at night

items.ar: استعمل السواك إذا قمت من الليل
items.tr: Use a siwak (tooth-cleaning stick) when you rise during the night

items.ar: … كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ يَشُوصُ فَاهُ بِالسِّوَاكِ
items.tr: … When he rose during the night, he scrubbed his mouth with a siwak (tooth-cleaning stick).

items.ar: مسلم 255
items.tr: Muslim 255

items.ar: غسل الوجه واليدين عند القيام من الليل
items.tr: Washing the face and hands when rising at night

items.ar: اغسل وجهك ويديك إذا قمت من الليل ثم عد إلى نومك
items.tr: Wash your face and hands when you rise during the night, then return to sleep

items.ar: … أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَقَضَى حَاجَتَهُ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ نَامَ
items.tr: … The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, rose during the night, relieved himself, washed his face and hands, then slept.

items.ar: مسلم 304
items.tr: Muslim 304

items.ar: دعاء القيام من الليل للتهجد
items.tr: The supplication when rising at night for tahajjud

items.ar: ادع بدعاء قيام الليل إذا قمت للتهجد
items.tr: Say the night-prayer dua (supplication) when you rise for tahajjud (night prayer)

items.ar: … اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَلَكَ الحَمْدُ أَنْتَ الحَقُّ وَوَعْدُكَ الحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ حَقٌّ، وَقَوْلُكَ حَقٌّ، وَالجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَقٌّ، وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ، اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، أَنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ …
items.tr: … O Allah, all praise belongs to You. You sustain the heavens, the earth and all within them. All praise belongs to You; Yours is the dominion of the heavens, the earth and all within them. All praise belongs to You; You are the light of the heavens, the earth and all within them. All praise belongs to You; You are the King of the heavens and earth. All praise belongs to You; You are the Truth, Your promise is true, meeting You is true, Your word is true, Paradise is true, the Fire is true, the prophets are true, Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is true, and the Hour is true. O Allah, to You I submit, in You I believe, upon You I rely, to You I turn, by You I contend and to You I refer for judgment. Forgive me what I have done before and what I do later, what I conceal and what I disclose. You are Al-Muqaddim (the One who brings forward), and You are Al-Muakhkhir (the One who puts back). None is worthy of worship except You …

items.ar: البخاري 1120
items.tr: Al-Bukhari 1120

items.ar: افتتاح قيام الليل بركعتين خفيفتين
items.tr: Beginning night prayer with two brief rakahs

items.ar: افتتح قيامك بركعتين خفيفتين
items.tr: Begin your night prayer with two brief rakahs (units of prayer)

items.ar: … كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ لِيُصَلِّيَ، افْتَتَحَ صَلَاتَهُ بِرَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ
items.tr: … When Allah's Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, rose at night to pray, he began his prayer with two brief rakahs (units of prayer).

items.ar: مسلم 767
items.tr: Muslim 767

items.ar: عدد ركعات قيام الليل وصفتها
items.tr: The number and manner of the rakahs of night prayer

items.ar: صل إحدى عشرة ركعة في قيامك وأطل فيهن
items.tr: Pray eleven rakahs (units of prayer) in your night prayer and make them long

items.ar: … مَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَزِيدُ فِي رَمَضَانَ وَلاَ فِي غَيْرِهِ عَلَى إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً يُصَلِّي أَرْبَعًا، فَلاَ تَسَلْ عَنْ حُسْنِهِنَّ وَطُولِهِنَّ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي أَرْبَعًا، فَلاَ تَسَلْ عَنْ حُسْنِهِنَّ وَطُولِهِنَّ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي ثَلاَثًا …
items.tr: … Allah's Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, did not exceed eleven rakahs (units of prayer), in Ramadan or otherwise. He prayed four: do not ask about their beauty and length. Then he prayed four: do not ask about their beauty and length. Then he prayed three …

items.ar: البخاري 1147
items.tr: Al-Bukhari 1147

items.ar: الوتر أول الليل لمن خاف أن لا يقوم
items.tr: Witr early in the night for one who fears not rising later

items.ar: أوتر أول الليل إن خفت ألا تقوم آخره
items.tr: Pray witr (odd-numbered prayer) early in the night if you fear you will not rise at its end

items.ar: … مَنْ خَافَ أَنْ لَا يَقُومَ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ فَلْيُوتِرْ أَوَّلَهُ، وَمَنْ طَمِعَ أَنْ يَقُومَ آخِرَهُ فَلْيُوتِرْ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ، فَإِنَّ صَلَاةَ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ مَشْهُودَةٌ، وَذَلِكَ أَفْضَلُ
items.tr: … Whoever fears not rising at the end of the night should pray witr (odd-numbered prayer) at its beginning. Whoever expects to rise at its end should pray witr at the end, for prayer at the end of the night is witnessed, and that is better.

items.ar: مسلم 755
items.tr: Muslim 755

items.ar: انتهاء الوتر إلى السحر
items.tr: Finishing witr in the time before dawn

items.ar: أوتر في أي جزء من ليلك وليكن منتهاه السحر
items.tr: Pray witr (odd-numbered prayer) in any part of your night, ending by the time before dawn

items.ar: … مِنْ كُلِّ اللَّيْلِ قَدْ أَوْتَرَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ، وَأَوْسَطِهِ، وَآخِرِهِ، فَانْتَهَى وِتْرُهُ إِلَى السَّحَرِ
items.tr: … Allah's Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, prayed witr (odd-numbered prayer) in every part of the night: its beginning, middle and end. His witr eventually ended in the time before dawn.

items.ar: مسلم 745
items.tr: Muslim 745

items.ar: من نعس في الصلاة فليرقد
items.tr: Whoever becomes drowsy during prayer should sleep

items.ar: ارقد إذا نعست في صلاتك حتى يذهب عنك النوم
items.tr: Sleep if you become drowsy during salah (prayer), until the drowsiness passes

items.ar: … إِذَا نَعَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَلْيَرْقُدْ، حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ عَنْهُ النَّوْمُ، فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا صَلَّى وَهُوَ نَاعِسٌ، لاَ يَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ يَسْتَغْفِرُ فَيَسُبُّ نَفْسَهُ
items.tr: … If one of you becomes drowsy while praying, let him sleep until the drowsiness passes. When one of you prays while drowsy, he does not know: perhaps he intends to seek forgiveness but instead curses himself.

items.ar: البخاري 212
items.tr: Al-Bukhari 212

items.ar: قضاء قيام الليل من النهار إذا فاته
items.tr: Making up missed night prayer during the day

items.ar: اقض قيام ليلك في النهار إذا فاتك
items.tr: Make up your night prayer during the day if you miss it

items.ar: … كَانَ إِذَا فَاتَتْهُ الصَّلَاةُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مِنْ وَجَعٍ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ، صَلَّى مِنَ النَّهَارِ ثِنْتَيْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً
items.tr: … When he missed night prayer because of pain or another reason, he prayed twelve rakahs (units of prayer) during the day.

items.ar: مسلم 746
items.tr: Muslim 746
